cards.title: Surgical Refinement
cards.description: Precision fixes without over-polishing. Corrects anatomy & geometry while preserving raw aesthetic.
cards.original: Enhance this reference image with surgical precision. Preserve exactly: lighting direction, color palette, compositional framing, atmospheric mood, and any intentional stylistic roughness or painterly texture. Selectively refine ONLY where needed: correct anatomical inconsistencies (hands, fingers, limbs), clarify facial features and eye alignment, resolve ambiguous or broken geometry, sharpen focal details. Do NOT over-smooth, do NOT add artificial sheen, do NOT alter the original artistic grain or mood. Maintain the image's raw character while fixing obvious generative artifacts.

renderPassDisclaimer: These prompts attempt to generate render passes from images. Results are approximations—not pixel-accurate technical outputs. Best for creative/visual use, not precision compositing.

extractionFindings.scope: HTML data-prompt attributes and JavaScript strings in inline onclick handlers were not extracted.
extractionFindings.overallCoverage: Not exhaustive. Repair extraction and re-audit before reviewing all other families.

preservationNotes: Scene Lock asks to preserve composition while changing viewpoint. Retain for compatibility; any behavioral change requires an explicit separate decision.
Photo Enhancement permits cropping/deleting details, unlike preservation recipes. Keep separate.
Scene Description and Image1/Image2/Image3 placeholders remain literal until an explicit V6 input mapping is implemented.
None disables the additional prefix only; the common style/lighting/palette preservation suffix still applies.
No source-local AI request or project storage. Shared theme stores theme settings and can normalize displayed text.
Render-pass terminology is creative approximative output, not a calibrated normals/depth/GI contract; do not silently rewrite prompts.
portingRequirements: Use textContent/DOM nodes for subject and generated text, never unescaped innerHTML.
Do not run shared theme cleanText() over V6 prompt payloads; test display/copy equivalence including markup-like text and repeated whitespace.
Send each angle as a separate output; Copy All retains labeled blocks separated by two newlines.
Preserve ordered selection, empty prefix, Unicode and significant trailing prefix spaces.
Test clipboard failures visibly and add the explicit send-to-aggregator action without triggering generation.
